result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback position: Customer retains a convenience-termination right on notice more favorable than the fallback range, early-termination charges are capped at three months' charges, and prepaid post-termination charges are refunded. No Vendor convenience-termination right is added. The changes are targeted and preserve the original scope and prerequisite-attachment limitation. Drafting is professional, though it does not reach the preferred position because early-termination charges remain, and 'one month's' notice effective only at month-end is not identical to a fixed 30-day right.
